limitations: Paper (PMID 27806443) full text was not read; no claim cites it.
Age 30Y6M and sex female come from Cellosaurus, not the deposit.
No factor value column: the standard vs HDPR-exclusion difference is an acquisition-method difference, expressed only in the source name and data file, not as a sample variable.
Source names and the pairing of exclusion run N with technical replicate N are our own inference from file names; no deposited mapping file.

Reduction/alkylation reagents not named in the deposit (Mascot header gives Carbamidomethyl only), so those optional columns are omitted. Collision energy, passage number, culture medium, storage temperature not stated.
Dissociation HCD is inferred from the method file name in the RAW header (Hela_1.raw only checked), assumed for all runs.
Search outputs are Mascot .dat; Hela_1.dat header read for parameters, others assumed identical. Mascot instrument field says ESI-TRAP, ignored in favour of protocol text and RAW header.
